  PROBLEM: gate_job_findings() decides that a job is stale (from a run before the split) by its bare name alone. A post-split `validate-scripts` job that is skipped at job level (because `source` or `resolve-version` failed, or the run was cancelled before the matrix expanded) is listed under its bare name with conclusion `skipped`, so it is wrongly counted in `stale_jobs`.
  WHY: All reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low): only the `CI_BUDGET_GATE outcome=read ... stale_jobs=1` log line is wrong and contradicts the documented meaning in README.md and agents.d/10220-release-validate-scripts-legs.md; no issue is wrongly filed or missed, because `job_duration_findings` (line 171) already drops skipped jobs. Suggested fix: `stale_jobs = sum(1 for job in gate_jobs if job.get("name") in matrix_keys and job.get("conclusion") != "skipped")`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
